title: English Around the World
text:
English is spoken by millions of people around the world. Many of them do not speak it as their first language. Instead, they use English to talk with people from other countries. For this reason, it is often called a global language.

English is important for travel and business. Pilots and air traffic controllers use it to talk to each other. Many companies also use English in their emails and meetings. Students learn it at school because it can help them find better jobs.

questions.text: Why is English often called a global language?
options: Because only people in one country speak it
Because it is used to talk with people from other countries
Because it is the oldest language in the world
Because all books are written in it

questions.text: What do pilots and air traffic controllers use English for?
What can we infer about students who learn English to get better jobs?
options: They think English can help their careers
They do not like their jobs at all
They plan to work only in their home country
They never need to speak to other people

questions.text: What can we infer about the many people who do not speak English as a first language?
options: Many of them learned it later in life for practical reasons
English is too difficult for children to learn
Only pilots are able to speak English

paragraph_translations: El inglés lo hablan millones de personas en todo el mundo. Muchas de ellas no lo hablan como primera lengua. En cambio, usan el inglés para hablar con personas de otros países. Por esta razón, a menudo se le llama lengua global.

El inglés es importante para viajar y para los negocios. Los pilotos y los controladores aéreos lo usan para comunicarse entre ellos. Muchas empresas también usan el inglés en sus correos electrónicos y reuniones. Los estudiantes lo aprenden en la escuela porque les puede ayudar a encontrar mejores trabajos.
